column1: # Polish: captions of the official program. Other text falls back to English.

column2: Number of rows scrolled at once

column1: 全键编程模板 : 提供MMORPG等游戏所需的多按键自定义编程功能，若FPS/TPS射击类游戏玩家可选用更专业的左键编程模板进行设置。
column2: Full key programming template (+/-/M): Provides custom multi-key programming functions for MMORPG and other games.  For FPS/TPS shooting games, players can choose a specialized left key programming template

column1: 灵敏度设置 : 提供鼠标的分辨率CPI，按键响应，报告率，微精校准LOD，滚轮及指针等灵敏度的功能设置。
column2: Sensitivity settings: Offers sensitivity adjustments for mouse resolution (CPI), button response, report rate, fine calibration (LOD), scroll wheel, pointer, and other functions.

column1: 编程设置 : 提供多种编程平台的“组合键”“左键编程”“奥斯卡II”“狙击键”等编程组合设置，并在按键设置中绑定编程按键使用。
column2: Programming Settings: Provides programming combinations such as "combination keys," "left key programming," "Oscar II," and "sniper keys" for various programming platforms, and binds programming keys in the key settings.

column1: 灯光设置：提供鼠标灯光亮度，灯效控制及RGB编辑等设置。（因产品功能不同，灯光设置会有所差异)
column2: Lighting settings: Offers settings for mouse lighting brightness, lightning effect control, and RGB editing. (Light settings may vary by product.)

column1: 其他设置 : 提供鼠标软件与硬件等设备设置。
column2: Other Settings: Offers device settings for mouse software and hardware.
